question: How does the goddess govern and empower the actions of the lord of medicine?
premises: The goddess is the sovereign of the dharma of the lord of medicine.
The goddess gives the actions of the lord of medicine.
inference: The goddess presides over and enables the healing functions of the medicinal lord.
plain_english: She is the sovereign goddess of the dharma of the lord of medicine and the giver of the actions of the lord of medicine.
